newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin recovery going according to plan.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin recovery going according to plan.

text.p: Boris Yeltsin's recovery from heart surgery is going according to plan, his spokesman said on Friday.

"All indicators are stable. His movements are being expanded," Sergei Yastrzhembsky told a news briefing. He said a planned address to the nation was still being prepared but did not say when it would be.
Yastrzhembsky had said on Tuesday that Yeltsin would address the nation within days.
On Friday he said no timetable for an address had been set, and it had not yet been decided whether it would be on television or radio.

He said doctors wanted a gradual approach to the president's recovery from the quintuple bypass operation which he underwent on November 5. "In the near future there are no meetings planned in his schedule," he said.
Yastrzhembsky said Yeltsin's imagemakers were deciding when would be the right time for him to appear. "You understand, the imagemakers want the president's appearance to have a big impact," he said.
